items.title: Dolly Douroux Adams Interview, 1962-04-18
items.q: Well, at times, Louis Armstrong played with us. Then other times, there was Kid Ory.

ctx.x: It seems he always was he had a special name. I can't think of it.

Well, he may know what he called it, but we always called it Mineta's Band. Mineta's Band. Yeah. Well, at times, Louis Armstrong played with us. Then other times, there was Kid Ory. It was... Is that a fellow? I can't think of him right now, but I will get to it.
